analysis: The only change in this unit is one line added to a test helper: a `case .logprobs: return "L"` branch (head line 37) in `trace` in NemotronSuperLocalOutputTests.swift. It makes the switch over MLXServerGenerationEvent exhaustive after a `.logprobs` event case was added. This is test-only code. It adds no production behavior, no new attack surface, and does not touch authorization, attestation, encryption, key handling, or cache storage. The surrounding tests (for example testCompleteLogprobsCarryTheStreamsEntries) exercise logprobs carried through NemotronSuperCompleteLogprobs and EngineV2LogprobsChannel. They also cover fail-closed tool/structured-output validation, bounded buffers, and trusted-schema-metadata handling, and none of those paths are altered here. The production logprobs feature itself is outside this unit. Whether it exposes extra token-level data on the provider-to-coordinator leg (T-008, TB-002) or touches the prefix cache (T-041) depends on non-supplied source. The next pass should check that logprobs are sealed with the same response encryption and respect the fail-closed behavior. This test file gives no evidence of any regression.
